<documents>
<document id="cushion-repayment">
RepayingˆCushionˆWhenˆCushionˆcoversˆaˆpurchase,ˆyourˆbalanceˆgoesˆbelowˆzero.ˆHere'sˆhowˆitˆgetsˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆAutomaticˆrepaymentˆAnyˆmoneyˆthatˆcomesˆin,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆaˆtransferˆorˆaˆrefund,ˆgoesˆtowardˆtheˆnegativeˆbalanceˆfirst.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆdoˆanything.ˆ##ˆPayingˆitˆbackˆyourselfˆYouˆcanˆaddˆmoneyˆatˆanyˆtimeˆbyˆtransfer,ˆBrookPayˆfromˆanotherˆmember,ˆorˆaˆcashˆdepositˆatˆaˆstore.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆstaysˆnegativeˆ-ˆAfterˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆuntilˆyou'reˆbackˆatˆzeroˆandˆmeetˆtheˆdirectˆdepositˆrequirementˆagain.ˆ-ˆAfterˆ60ˆdays,ˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestricted.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆaddˆmoney,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆspendˆorˆsendˆitˆuntilˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆrepaid.ˆ##ˆCostˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterestˆforˆusingˆCushion,ˆandˆnoneˆforˆrepayingˆlate.ˆTheˆonlyˆconsequencesˆareˆsuspensionˆandˆrestriction.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆcloseˆmyˆaccountˆwhileˆit'sˆnegative?ˆNo.ˆBringˆtheˆbalanceˆtoˆzeroˆfirst.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-fraud-alerts">
HowˆfraudˆalertsˆworkˆWhenˆweˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆthatˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆyouˆaˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆandˆbyˆtextˆifˆyou'veˆturnedˆthatˆon.ˆ##ˆAnsweringˆanˆalertˆTheˆalertˆshowsˆtheˆmerchant,ˆamountˆandˆlocation.ˆTapˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆorˆ"No,ˆthatˆwasn'tˆme".ˆ-ˆ**Yes:**ˆtheˆcardˆisˆunlockedˆstraightˆaway.ˆTryˆtheˆpurchaseˆagain.ˆ-ˆ**No:**ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlocked.ˆWe'llˆguideˆyouˆthroughˆreportingˆitˆandˆdisputingˆanyˆotherˆcharges.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆwithinˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ##ˆIsˆthisˆalertˆreal?ˆRealˆalertsˆappearˆinsideˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆAˆtextˆalertˆonlyˆeverˆasksˆyouˆtoˆreplyˆYESˆorˆNO,ˆandˆneverˆcontainsˆaˆlink.ˆWeˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆcardˆnumber,ˆPIN,ˆpasswordˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcodeˆtoˆconfirmˆanˆalert.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆcallsˆyouˆaboutˆaˆfraudˆalert,ˆhangˆupˆandˆopenˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆ##ˆTooˆmanyˆalerts?ˆAlertsˆareˆmoreˆcommonˆwhenˆyouˆshopˆsomewhereˆnewˆorˆabroad.ˆTheyˆgetˆlessˆfrequentˆasˆourˆsystemsˆlearnˆyourˆpatterns.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="close-balance">
WhatˆhappensˆtoˆyourˆmoneyˆwhenˆyouˆcloseˆWhenˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆweˆsendˆanyˆremainingˆmoneyˆtoˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆweˆsendˆitˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆaˆlinkedˆexternalˆaccount,ˆweˆsendˆtheˆbalanceˆthereˆbyˆACH.ˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆdon't,ˆweˆmailˆaˆcheckˆtoˆtheˆaddressˆonˆyourˆprofile.ˆEitherˆway,ˆit'sˆsentˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdaysˆofˆclosing.ˆ##ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆMoneyˆinˆyourˆpockets,ˆandˆanyˆinterestˆearnedˆupˆtoˆtheˆclosingˆdate,ˆisˆincludedˆinˆtheˆpayout.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆthatˆarriveˆlaterˆIfˆaˆmerchantˆrefundˆorˆotherˆcreditˆarrivesˆafterˆyourˆaccountˆisˆclosed,ˆweˆsendˆitˆtoˆyouˆtheˆsameˆway.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆcloseˆMakeˆsureˆyourˆaddressˆisˆupˆtoˆdateˆifˆyou'llˆbeˆpaidˆbyˆcheck.ˆChecksˆcan'tˆbeˆsentˆtoˆaˆPOˆbox.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆsendˆitˆsomewhereˆelse?ˆNo.ˆWeˆcanˆonlyˆsendˆyourˆbalanceˆtoˆanˆexternalˆaccountˆinˆyourˆownˆname,ˆorˆbyˆcheckˆtoˆyourˆaddressˆonˆfile.ˆWeˆcan'tˆsendˆitˆtoˆanotherˆperson.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
